prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
Done.

[goal] Low-poly 3D wallpaper of Hokusai's *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* as a single-file scene, plus a result.json record of what was taken from the print.

[action] Built `./scene/index.html` (Three.js 0.170 from the allowed CDN, no textures, everything in code) and `./result.json`; iterated the composition against live browser screenshots (two revision rounds: fixed the wave curl that was occluding the wall and re-tuned palette/framing).

[result]
- **Print identified**: *Kanagawa oki nami ura*, Katsushika Hokusai, c. 1831 — public domain. I know it from the image itself: the title cartouche in the upper left (富嶽三十六景 神奈川沖浪裏) and the distinctive wave/Fuji composition.
- **Boats: 3** — one under the big wave (left), the large salmon-hulled one in the center foreground, one climbing the right swell; the scene builds exactly three boats with hunched white crew.
- **Mountain: Mount Fuji** — snow-capped low-poly cone sitting small in the right-center background between the waves, as in the print.
- **Composition taken from the print**: broad indigo wave face with white stipple specks (240 instanced dots), foam claw on the crest only, mottled light/dark water in the foreground, soft hex-clouds upper right, cream paper sky.
- **Palette** recorded in result.json: paper `#f0e5cf`, wave indigo `#24496b`, trough `#1a3350`, light band `#5a89a8`, foam `#eef0e9`, salmon hull `#d8896a`, Fuji snow `#f7f6f1`.
- **Gentle motion**: wave sways, water undulates, boats rock and bob, clouds drift.
- **Verified live**: opened the file in a browser, screenshot shows the wave wall, all three boats fully in frame, Fuji, and clouds matching the print's layout; the final frame is the one described above. Browser tabs opened were closed (remaining target already gone).

[next] Open `scene/index.html` directly in any browser with network access to Google Fonts and jsDelivr — no build step. If the client wants, the motion amplitudes (boat rocking, water undulation) are one-line tweaks at the bottom of the file.
